one_liner: Pay-as-you-go SEO data APIs for SERP, keywords, backlinks and on-page.
auth_notes: HTTP Basic with account email plus a dedicated API password; base64 Authorization header on every call.
credential_path: Self-serve signup, then copy API login/password from dashboard; free trial plus sandbox endpoints available.
breadth_note: Seven-plus API families: SERP, Keywords Data, Labs, Backlinks, OnPage, Business Data, Domain Analytics.

mcp.note: Official v3 TypeScript MCP server; earlier v2 server deprecated in a separate repo.

rate_limits: ~2,000 requests/min general; some endpoints far lower
notes: Cleanest build target in the category: documented Basic auth, sandbox, postback/pingback callbacks, official MCP server.

one_liner: SEO platform exposing a Data API and a project-management Project API.
auth_notes: Single API key works across both APIs; sent as Authorization: Token <key>, or an apikey query parameter.
credential_path: Create key in-app via API dashboard 'Create API key'; works on free trial and paid subscriptions.
breadth_note: Data API for raw SEO/AEO datasets plus Project API for rank tracking, audits and project CRUD.

mcp.note: Official MCP server documented under integrations; official Claude skills catalogue at github.com/seranking/seo-skills.

rate_limits: ~10 rps Data API, ~5 rps Project API; trial 1 rps
notes: Rate-limit figures partly sourced from MCP server description; webhook support not confirmed in docs reviewed.

one_liner: Backlink and keyword intelligence API metered in per-plan API units.
auth_notes: API v3 keys created by workspace owners/admins in account settings; MCP uses separate MCP keys as bearer tokens.
credential_path: Owner/admin creates key in Ahrefs account settings; requires an eligible paid plan, plus limited free test queries.
breadth_note: Site Explorer, Keywords Explorer, Rank Tracker, Site Audit, brand/AI visibility, management endpoints; OpenAPI spec published.

mcp.note: Remote official MCP server; the older local repo github.com/ahrefs/ahrefs-mcp-server is archived and outdated.

rate_limits: 60 requests/min default; dynamic throttling; API units per plan
blocker: Paid plan required and every billable call burns non-refundable units (50-unit minimum).
notes: Correction to older assumptions: API is no longer Enterprise-only, it is 'available on eligible paid plans' with free test queries.

one_liner: AI web scraper with API, SDKs, CLI and rotating residential proxies.
auth_notes: API token created in dashboard account settings (API Tokens page) and sent as a bearer token.
credential_path: Self-serve signup, no card; free tier includes 1,000 tokens and API-based scraping, token from account settings.
breadth_note: Scraper run/endpoint activation, results retrieval, plus Python/Node SDKs, LangChain integration and CLI.

mcp.note: Docs index lists an official MrScraper MCP server page under getting-started; exact endpoint URL not verified (page 404'd on direct fetch).

notes: Webhooks confirmed in docs index; no rate-limit page found. Hosted MCP endpoint URL unconfirmed. Paid plans unlock webhooks/workflows.

one_liner: Actor marketplace and cloud runtime for scrapers, with full platform API.
auth_notes: Apify API token from Console API & Integrations page as bearer; MCP server also supports browser OAuth sign-in.
credential_path: Self-serve signup, copy API token from Apify Console API & Integrations page; free plan credits available.
breadth_note: Actors, runs, datasets, key-value stores, request queues, builds, tasks, schedules, webhooks, billing.

mcp.note: Official hosted server at https://mcp.apify.com; four discovery/docs tools usable unauthenticated.

rate_limits: ~30 requests/sec per user on MCP; 429 with retry guidance
notes: Official MCP confirmed. Webhooks, schedules, request queues and tasks are REST-only features per Apify docs.

one_liner: LLM-ready scrape, crawl, map, search and extract API for agents.
auth_notes: fc- prefixed API key sent as Authorization: Bearer; MCP additionally offers OAuth sign-in and limited keyless access.
credential_path: Self-serve signup with no card; 1,000 free credits/month, key from firecrawl.dev/app/api-keys.
breadth_note: Scrape, crawl, map, search, extract, agent and monitor endpoints plus Node/Python SDKs.

mcp.note: Official hosted MCP at https://mcp.firecrawl.dev/v2/mcp (and /v2/mcp-oauth); keyless mode with daily limits.

notes: Webhooks cover crawl, batch scrape, extract, agent and monitor events with retry backoff and auto-deactivation.

one_liner: Proxy network plus Web Unlocker, SERP, Scraper APIs and Browser API.
auth_notes: API token from account user settings used as bearer; proxy zones additionally use username/password proxy credentials.
credential_path: Self-serve signup; 5,000 free credits/month with no card, token from user settings page.
breadth_note: Web Unlocker, SERP API, Web Scraper API across 40+ site extractors, Scraping Browser, zone management, datasets.

mcp.note: Official MCP server exposing Web Unlocker, SERP, structured extractors and remote Scraping Browser; API_TOKEN env var.

rate_limits: Scraper API trigger 20/min, 60/hour; zone concurrency limits
notes: Rate-limit model is per-zone concurrency rather than global RPM; card may be required as verification beyond free credits.

one_liner: Open-source CLI that hunts usernames across 400+ social networks.
auth_notes: No accounts, no API keys, no hosted service; it queries public profile URLs directly from the local machine.
credential_path: No credentials exist; install via pipx install sherlock-project or the official Docker image.
breadth_note: Single capability: username-to-profile enumeration, output to CSV/JSON/txt. No server-side API surface.

mcp.note: Community FastMCP wrapper around the CLI; other community wrappers exist on Apify and in OSINT MCP bundles.

blocker: No hosted API and no credentials to connect; CLI must be self-hosted and wrapped.
notes: MIT-licensed local tool. A connector is only possible by self-hosting the CLI behind your own service; nothing to authenticate against.

one_liner: Aggregates 30+ B2B data vendors behind one contact-enrichment API.
auth_notes: API key passed in the x-api-key header; an API-key management endpoint exists but key issuance process is undocumented.
credential_path: No self-serve signup found; site's only CTA is 'Book a Call'. Key provisioning appears sales/onboarding-led.
breadth_note: About 13 services: contact prospecting/enrichment, company search, email verify, phone enrich, job-change detection.

mcp.note: No official MCP server found. Docs do reference an 'Agent Skills' section for coding agents.

blocker: No self-serve signup or public pricing; API key requires sales contact.
notes: Public API docs do exist at docs.waterfall.io/v1 (base https://api.waterfall.io), contradicting 'no public docs'; access path is the blocker.

one_liner: GTM data platform; public developer API shipped mid-2026.
auth_notes: API key in the clay-api-key header; created in Settings > Account > API keys (beta) or via the clay CLI.
credential_path: Create key in Clay settings or 'clay api-keys create'; available on free, trial and paid plans.
breadth_note: Searches, Routines, Tables (read-only), Workflows (alpha), Me, Credits; inbound/outbound webhooks for row data.

mcp.note: Docs mention using Clay with 'MCP clients' and ship a coding-agent plugin/CLI, but no dedicated MCP server page found.

rate_limits: Documented rate-limits page; free 100 search results/month
blocker: Tables are read-only; structured table queries and paging past 100 rows need Enterprise API table sync.
notes: Updates the old 'no public API' assumption: a public API now exists, but write access to tables is still absent.
